4
Agyapadeɛ a ɛgu dɔteɛ anwenneɛ mu
1 # 2 Ko 3.6; 1 Ko 7.25 Saa nti, sɛ yɛnam Nyankopɔn mmɔborɔhunu so wɔ saa som yi nti, yɛmpa aba, 2#2 Ko 2.17; 1 Te 2.5 na mmom yɛapo aniwudeɛ a ɛhunta no, na yɛnnante anifire mu, anaasɛ yɛmfra Nyankopɔn asɛm no mu, na mmom yɛda nokorɛ no adi, de yi yɛn ho kyerɛ nnipa nyinaa, Nyankopɔn anim. 3#1 Ko 1.18 Na sɛ yɛn asɛmpa so akata a, ɛso akata wɔ wɔn a wɔreyera no mu; 4#Heb 1.3 wɔn mu na wiase nyame afira wɔn a wɔnnye nnie no adwene ani, na Kristo a ɔyɛ Nyankopɔn suban no animuonyam asɛmpa no hann anhyerɛn amma wɔn. 5#2 Ko 1.24 Na ɛnyɛ yɛn ho asɛm na yɛka, na mmom Kristo Yesu, sɛ ɔne Awurade, ɛne yɛn nso, sɛ Yesu nti yɛyɛ mo nkoa. 6#Gye 1.3; 2 Ko 3.18 Ɛfiri sɛ ɛyɛ Onyankopɔn a ɔkaa sɛ hann mfiri esum mu nhyerɛn no na wahyerɛn yɛn akoma mu, sɛ Nyankopɔn animuonyam a ɛwɔ Kristo anim no ho nimdeɛ hyerɛn.
Paulo ahoɔden firi Nyankopɔn nkyɛn
7 # 2 Ko 5.1 Na yɛwɔ saa agyapadeɛ yi wɔ dɔteɛ anwenneɛ mu, sɛdeɛ wɔbɛma no ada adi pefee na tumi a ɛboro soɔ no ayɛ Nyankopɔn dea, na amfiri yɛn mu. 8#2 Ko 1.8; 7.5 Ade nyinaa mu wɔhiahia yɛn ho, nanso yɛn home ntee; yɛn ho akyere yɛn, nanso yɛn ani ntanee. 9Wɔtaataa yɛn, nanso wɔmpaa yɛn akyi; wɔabɔ yɛn ato fam, nanso wɔnsɛee yɛn. 10#1 Ko 15.31 Daa yɛso Awurade Yesu wuo no wɔ yɛn nipadua mu nam, na Yesu nkwa no nso ada adi yɛn nipadua mu. 11#Rom 8.36 Ɛfiri sɛ yɛn a yɛte aseɛ yi, daa Yesu nti, wɔyi yɛn ma owuo, na Yesu nkwa no nso ada adi yɛn honam a ɛbɛwuo no mu. 12Enti owuo di dwuma wɔ yɛn mu, na nkwa di dwuma wɔ mo mu.
Daa nkwa ho anidasoɔ
13 # Dwom 116.10 Na sɛ yɛwɔ gyidie honhom korɔ no ara nti, sɛdeɛ wɔatwerɛ sɛ: Megye mediiɛ, na mekasaeɛ, yɛn nso yɛgye di na enti yɛkasa nso; 14#1 Ko 6.14 na yɛnim sɛ, deɛ ɔnyanee Awurade Yesu no bɛnyane yɛn nso, ne Yesu, na wayi yɛne mo akyerɛ. 15#2 Ko 1.3-6 Aane, mo nti na ne nyinaa yɛ, na adom no adɔɔso afa nnipa pii so ama aseda aboro so ama Onyankopɔn animuonyam.
Ɛtumi ba sɛ wɔnam seesei amanehunu so nya daa animuonyam
16 # 2 Ko 4.10; Efe 3.16 Yei nti na yɛmpa aba, na sɛ yɛn honam ani nipa yi resɛe mpo a, emu nohoa nipa no dane foforɔ daa daa. 17#Rom 8.17-18 Na yɛn seesei amanehunu a ɛyɛ hare yi resiesie daa animuonyam a ɛso kokuroo tra so pii ama yɛn, 18#Heb 11.1 na yɛnhwɛ nnoɔma a wɔhunu, na mmom yɛhwɛ nnoɔma a wɔnhunu; ɛfiri sɛ nnoɔma a wɔhunu no nkyɛ na atwa mu; na nnoɔma a wɔnhunu no na ɛtena hɔ daa.

pageProps.chapterText:
Saa nti, sɛ yɛnam Nyankopɔn mmɔborɔhunu so wɔ saa som yi nti, yɛmpa aba, na mmom yɛapo aniwudeɛ a ɛhunta no, na yɛnnante anifire mu, anaasɛ yɛmfra Nyankopɔn asɛm no mu, na mmom yɛda nokorɛ no adi, de yi yɛn ho kyerɛ nnipa nyinaa, Nyankopɔn anim. Na sɛ yɛn asɛmpa so akata a, ɛso akata wɔ wɔn a wɔreyera no mu; wɔn mu na wiase nyame afira wɔn a wɔnnye nnie no adwene ani, na Kristo a ɔyɛ Nyankopɔn suban no animuonyam asɛmpa no hann anhyerɛn amma wɔn. Na ɛnyɛ yɛn ho asɛm na yɛka, na mmom Kristo Yesu, sɛ ɔne Awurade, ɛne yɛn nso, sɛ Yesu nti yɛyɛ mo nkoa. Ɛfiri sɛ ɛyɛ Onyankopɔn a ɔkaa sɛ hann mfiri esum mu nhyerɛn no na wahyerɛn yɛn akoma mu, sɛ Nyankopɔn animuonyam a ɛwɔ Kristo anim no ho nimdeɛ hyerɛn.

Na yɛwɔ saa agyapadeɛ yi wɔ dɔteɛ anwenneɛ mu, sɛdeɛ wɔbɛma no ada adi pefee na tumi a ɛboro soɔ no ayɛ Nyankopɔn dea, na amfiri yɛn mu. Ade nyinaa mu wɔhiahia yɛn ho, nanso yɛn home ntee; yɛn ho akyere yɛn, nanso yɛn ani ntanee. Wɔtaataa yɛn, nanso wɔmpaa yɛn akyi; wɔabɔ yɛn ato fam, nanso wɔnsɛee yɛn. Daa yɛso Awurade Yesu wuo no wɔ yɛn nipadua mu nam, na Yesu nkwa no nso ada adi yɛn nipadua mu. Ɛfiri sɛ yɛn a yɛte aseɛ yi, daa Yesu nti, wɔyi yɛn ma owuo, na Yesu nkwa no nso ada adi yɛn honam a ɛbɛwuo no mu. Enti owuo di dwuma wɔ yɛn mu, na nkwa di dwuma wɔ mo mu.

Na sɛ yɛwɔ gyidie honhom korɔ no ara nti, sɛdeɛ wɔatwerɛ sɛ: Megye mediiɛ, na mekasaeɛ, yɛn nso yɛgye di na enti yɛkasa nso; na yɛnim sɛ, deɛ ɔnyanee Awurade Yesu no bɛnyane yɛn nso, ne Yesu, na wayi yɛne mo akyerɛ. Aane, mo nti na ne nyinaa yɛ, na adom no adɔɔso afa nnipa pii so ama aseda aboro so ama Onyankopɔn animuonyam.

Yei nti na yɛmpa aba, na sɛ yɛn honam ani nipa yi resɛe mpo a, emu nohoa nipa no dane foforɔ daa daa. Na yɛn seesei amanehunu a ɛyɛ hare yi resiesie daa animuonyam a ɛso kokuroo tra so pii ama yɛn, na yɛnhwɛ nnoɔma a wɔhunu, na mmom yɛhwɛ nnoɔma a wɔnhunu; ɛfiri sɛ nnoɔma a wɔhunu no nkyɛ na atwa mu; na nnoɔma a wɔnhunu no na ɛtena hɔ daa.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
